title: Renewal Velocity: Mini QBR Deck + Action Tracker
body:
Purpose
Quick, actionable 5-slide QBR mini-deck + a 2-week sprint-style renewal tracker for mid-market & enterprise accounts. Designed for an ops-driven CS team that needs a short exec-friendly deck plus a concrete action list to push renewals from intent -> signed.

Audience
- Customer Success Managers
- Account Execs (renewal owners)
- Solutions Eng for technical blockers
- Customer execs (as a 10-min briefing)

How to use this file
- Copy the 'deck slides' into the slide tool you use for customer-facing QBRs. Keep the deck <10 slides for execs.
- Use the renewal tracker as the single source of truth during a 2-week sprint; update daily.
- Tag linked tickets (Jira) in the tracker 'blocking' column.

MINI-DECK OUTLINE (5 slides)
Slide 1 — Executive Snapshot (1 slide)
- One-line account status: Green/Yellow/Red + renewal ARR + contract end date
- Quick: NRR trend (90d), usage trend (30d), and top 1 ask from customer
- Callout: primary risk (tech/usage/price) and primary upside (expansion/opportunity)

Slide 2 — What the Customer Uses (1 slide)
- Active endpoints / models in prod (list) + monthly tokens/requests (30d)
- Performance KPIs we own: P50 latency, error rate, cache hit %
- Recent infra incidents (last 90d) with mitigation status

Slide 3 — Value Realized (1 slide)
- Business outcomes: e.g., reduced response time, saved developer hours, 3x faster feature iteration
- Quantified wins (if available): x% conversion lift, y% reduction in infra spend, etc.
- Customer quotes / CSAT snippet

Slide 4 — Renewal Summary & Options (1 slide)
- Renewal date, ARR at renewal, recommended renewal package (standard vs enterprise)
- Proposed offers: term length, committed throughput, discount structure, pilot to enterprise path
- If risk = Yellow/Red: recommended mitigation steps and ETA to green

Slide 5 — Sprint Playbook & Asks (1 slide)
- 2-week sprint plan (owner initials): Technical unblock, Pricing proposal, Exec alignment meeting, Legal intake
- CTA for customer: 30-min decision meeting by DATE
- Internal asks: Solutions Eng availability, AE sign-off, Pricing approval

RENEWAL SPRINT TRACKER (copy into sheet)
Columns (as text): Account | Renewal Date | ARR | Risk | Primary Signal | Sprint Owner | Blockers (JIRA) | This Sprint Objective | 3-Day Check-in | Outcome | Next Step | Status
Sample row (text): Acme Corp | 2026-01-15 | $210k | Yellow | Usage down 35% vs 90d | A. Patel | CS-4821 | Get production latency <250ms + revised commercial | 2025-10-07: SE triage | Latency improved 280ms | Price incentive proposal | In progress
Notes on tracker usage:
- Risk scoring: Green = on track, Yellow = tactical issues (tech/usage), Red = churn risk (executive disengagement or major technical gap)
- Primary Signal: pick top one (Usage drop, Exec churn, Legal delay, Competitor RFP)
- Blockers: always point to a ticket (Jira/Cloud task) — reduces 'tribal knowledge'

PLAYBOOK (step-by-step)
1) Detect: signal detection matrix (usage thresholds, error spikes, billing changes, exec sentiment).
   - Metric triggers: 30% drop in requests or 40% increase in 5xx rate -> automatic flag
2) Triage (within 48 hours): SE deep-dive -> root cause hypothesis -> quick mitigation (cache config, model switch, routing change)
3) Re-engage (72 hours): AE schedules exec call; CS shares short deck (slides 1–3) + proposed fix
4) Commercial (7 days): present renewal options: conservative renewal (same tier + technical SLA), or enterprise (reserved capacity + priority support)
5) Close (14 days): confirm commercial terms, legal intake, contract signature; follow cadence for remediation if needs more time

Template Outreach Snippets (use in Slack/email)
- Slack quick ping (to AE + SE): "Heads up — flagged Acme (usage -35%). SE triage started (CS-4821). Proposed: enable prefix caching and schedule 30-min sync. Owner: A. Patel."
- Customer email (short): "Hi X — quick summary: we're seeing lower usage tied to tokenization mismatch. We've scheduled a fix and would like 30 mins to review options for the renewal. Proposed slots: DATE1/DATE2."

Escalation Flow (if Red)
- Day 0: CS lead call with AE and SE (owner).
- Day 2: Solutions Eng + engineering on-call deep dive; escalate to Eng Manager if no resolution.
- Day 4: AE opens exec to exec. If still unresolved by day 7, prepare a limited-time bridge offer (90-day extension + committed throughput) to avoid churn while we fix root cause.

Measurement & Signals to Track (recommended metrics)
- Product signals: daily active endpoints, tokens per active endpoint, P50/P95 latency, 5xx errors, cache hit rate
- Commercial signals: seat adoption (if applicable), feature usage breadth (new features launched vs used)
- Sentiment signals: NPS quote frequency, exec meeting cadence, support ticket cadence

Open questions / TODOs (notes to self)
- Need pricing language for a 'bridge' 90-day extension — ask Finance for precedent (linked: CONFLUENCE:CS/renewal-playbooks-v3).
- Verify legal turnaround time for enterprise addendum in NA vs EU (Priya to confirm).
- Decide whether to make the sprint tracker canonical in Salesforce or keep as Google Sheet (pros/cons below).

Pros/Cons: Salesforce as canonical
- Pros: single pane with account history, easier for AEs to update
- Cons: less flexible for daily sprint status updates, slower to edit in field

Pros/Cons: Google Sheet canonical
- Pros: fast updates, templated sprint view, better for multi-owner sync
- Cons: might diverge from CRM view -> requires periodic backfill

Appendix: Quick sample metrics snapshot (example values)
- 30d tokens: 3.2M (down 28% vs 90d)
- Active endpoints: 4 (stable)
- P50 latency: 270ms (target <250ms)
- 5xx rate: 0.4% (target <0.2%)
- NRR (90d): 98% (pressure on upsell)

Legal & Pricing templates to attach
- Short-form bridge: 90-day extension + 10% committed discount (TBD by Finance)
- Enterprise upgrade: reserved capacity + SLA (SLA template link: CONFLUENCE:LEGAL/SLA-TEMPLATES)

Footer:
- Owner: Anika Patel (CS lead for mid-market renewal sprints)
- Next update: 2025-10-28 (end of sprint)
- Contact: anika.patel@redwood.com / slack @anika

History / revision notes:

Unresolved items (flagged)
- Who will own 'commercial' for blended enterprise/hosted deals (AE or CS?). Recommend AE but needs confirmation.
- Formal approval threshold for discounts >15% (Finance)

End of doc
